Dataset_Status.txt on Zenodo still reads "Dataset will be made available upon publication of the paper." although files are listed and downloadable (one phase file fetched; video access HEAD-checked only). Subjects: the arXiv text describes clinical surgery recordings with inclusion criteria on pathologies but does not use the word "patients".
